author: EncryptedShoesHD
body:
In-game name: Kiaraphernelia
Banned by: Numberz_ (He's not a mod anymore)
Banned for: Trolling staff.
Banned on: May 29, 2015 2:33:15 AM GMT

I asked her to answer those questions:

1. Was your temp-ban or ban really false?
  • No, my ban was legit. I have been banned since may 29 2015 and you can check the logs to see when/why/who banned me. I'm am being completely honest. Take my word for it. And I promise I will not troll staff ever again, even though I had no intention in trolling staff in the first place.
2. Do you have any evidence to show the staff if was false?
  • No I don't have an evidence to prove it was false. My friend Danny, was arguing with admins and I decided to stick up for him because he was my friend. The staff then exclaimed that I threatened to ddos even though I had no clue what D.D.O.S was at the time. When I was sticking up for him even more things somehow escalated and I was banned for "trolling staff." I also believe this to be unfair because even if I was trolling, it was my first offense and I got a permanent ban. These are my reasons for why I believe injustice was conducted when the decision to ban me was reached.
3. Have you waited long enough to be un-banned?
  • I really enjoyed avicus and I am tired of waiting for my one of my favorite servers! It was May 29th and now it is March the 14th so that is almost a year give or take.
4. Have you been caught ban evading?
  • No, I have abided by all of the ban evasions and took my punishment.
5. Have you appealed a ban before?
  • I haven't appealed a ban before, this is my very first time and I am hoping this will all go well.
6. Will you respect the rules from now on? Try not to break the rules again.
  • I promise I will respect the rules from now on. And I wont break them.
7. Why do you believe that you should be unbanned?
  • I believe I should be unbanned because I enjoy the server, games, environment, and great community. I loved playing on this server 2 years ago and I thought it was cool to have team based pvp. I also believe I should be unbanned because in my eyes, I did not do anything wrong. I simply tried to help my friend on an argument and was then unjustly banned.


Yeah, that's it. Asking a senior staff to take it over, since Numberz_ is not a staff member anymore.

Regards,
~ DeliciousShoesHD, Avicus Moderator
~ Kiaraphernelia, banned user
